general_information.name: OH, UM… YOU MEAN LIKE THE NAME ON THE PAPERWORK? I’M NOT QUITE SURE HOW YOU WANT IT SAID. THERE’S JOANNE, AND I THINK STIRLING IS THE LAST NAME, BUT I’M NOT SURE IF YOU WANT THE WHOLE THING ALL AT ONCE OR… COULD YOU SAY IT AGAIN MAYBE?

current_concerns.primary_problems: It’s been a lot of mood stuff, I suppose… low mood, getting snappy and tearful, and then the sleep has been awful with the night sweats. Also I keep losing my place at work, concentrating is harder than it used to be. It’s been going on for about three years, I think.
current_concerns.goals: I just want to sleep through the night, honestly, and stop snapping at my family.

past_psychiatric_history.previous_diagnoses: I don’t have any previous diagnosis to list.

medications.current_medications: Medication 1: Name Or Description: Transdermal oestradiol.; Dose: It’s one patch, twice a week.; Start Or Duration: Started in 2025, if I’m remembering right.; Side Effects: Just a bit of mild skin irritation where the patch goes.

medical_history.medical_conditions: Just the perimenopause, that’s the only one I know of.

family_psychiatric_history.family_psychiatric_history_details: Family member 1: Name Or Description: My mother.; Diagnosis Or Condition: Depression during menopause.; Additional Details: She was treated with medication. That’s all I know.

substance_use.nonmedical_alcohol_use: Status: Current; Substance or product: Wine.; Quantity or frequency: Two glasses, three evenings a week.; Duration: About twenty years.

education_employment_legal_history.employment_history: Job 1: Name Or Description: Crestline Group.; Job Title: Human resources advisor.; Dates: 2004 to present.

personal_history.early_childhood: I was born and raised in Toronto, and it was an ordinary, happy childhood. Nothing much to report, really.
personal_history.adolescence_early_adulthood: I completed a business degree, and there weren’t any significant difficulties that I can think of.
personal_history.significant_relationships: My marriage — it’s current, and we’ve been married for 24 years. We have two adult children too.
personal_history.future_goals: I just want to feel steady again and enjoy work.
